title: MedDefense Unified Event Schema
description: Canonical event record used by all downstream modules.

timestamp.description: ISO‑8601 UTC timestamp of the original event.
timestamp.justification: Provides a single chronological reference for cross‑source correlation.

hostname.description: Fully qualified or short name of the host where the event was captured.
hostname.justification: Enables source‑based filtering and host‑level triage.

source_type.description: Origin of the record before normalization.
source_type.justification: Allows downstream modules to apply source‑specific enrichment.

event_category.description: High‑level event category such as authentication, process, file, network or audit.
event_category.justification: Needed by 3x02 detection rules and 3x03 triage filters to group events independently of source vendor.

severity.description: Risk level assigned to the event.
severity.justification: Enables automated escalation logic in 3x02 and provides analyst context for triage.

user.description: Username associated with the event, if any.
user.justification: Required to link authentication and privilege‑elevation events to a specific account.

process_name.description: Executable name that produced the event.
process_name.justification: Essential for process‑based detection and forensic analysis.

src_ip.description: Source IP address of a network or audit event.
src_ip.justification: Needed to map inbound/outbound traffic for incident response.

dst_ip.description: Destination IP address of a network or audit event.
dst_ip.justification: Required to identify target hosts in attack chains.

src_port.justification: Allows fine‑grained protocol filtering for network and audit events.

dst_port.justification: Used by detection rules to identify service‑level anomalies.

protocol.description: Transport or application protocol of the event.
protocol.justification: Required for protocol‑based rule matching in 3x02.

raw_message.description: Full unmodified source line from the original log.
raw_message.justification: Preserves context for manual triage and forensic review.

event_data.description: Parsed key/value pairs extracted from the source record.
event_data.justification: Provides access to vendor‑specific details without bloating top‑level fields.

source_origin.description: Indicates whether the record came from evidence or student telemetry.
source_origin.justification: Allows downstream systems to weight provenance during analysis.
